root_idea.summary: The root centers on rising above, elevation, prominence, and the branching or extension of something from a base.
root_idea.development: From the upper part or branch come related senses of height, superiority, branching and subdivision, derivation from a foundation, and certain specialized uses involving first emergence or ascent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun فَرْع is a distinct lexical item meaning a branch or upper extension.

senses.definition: A branch or branching extension, especially of a tree.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of the good tree, فَرْعُهَا is the tree's upper branching growth, contrasted with its firmly rooted أصل; the singular form is rendered contextually as “branches.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overtop or surpass in height; by extension, to excel or be superior in eminence, nobility, beauty, or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or group in relation to others, especially for superiority in stature or rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend or descend a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The direction depends on the construction and usage; the sources record both contrary senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or assail someone's head with a staff or sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the head as object and the instrument expressed or understood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull in and stop a horse by its bridle and bit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To interpose between disputing parties, restrain them, and bring about reconciliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بين to describe intervening as a barrier between people or animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take the first object of a chase and shed its blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression for the first quarry taken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be abundant or free from deficiency in the hair of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a distinct vocalized verb from the height and branch senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To derive or deduce questions, propositions, or subsidiary matters from a fundamental principle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical or figurative construction with an أصل as the source and فروع as its derivatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffice someone and undertake responsibility for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alight at someone's abode as a guest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with بِـ; synonymous with نزَلَ in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possibly, to descend or lower oneself in meanness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning occurs in a disputed phrase whose transmitted wording is suspected of corruption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel around a land and learn its condition or circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of surveying or traversing a territory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to bring forth their first offspring; of people, to sacrifice a firstling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The firstling may be of a camel, sheep, or goat; the latter use belongs to the pre-Islamic sacrificial custom described in the evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause bleeding, injure, or kill by making blood flow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an animal attacking livestock, a bit injuring a horse's mouth, or another agent causing bleeding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consummate sexual intercourse with a bride.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman or female animal, to begin bleeding, menstruate, or experience blood at childbirth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record variation as to whether the bleeding is before childbirth, during its pains, or at the beginning of menstruation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To begin or commence discourse, a narration, a journey, or an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with speech, a journey, a needful matter, or another thing as the object or complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek herbage among the first or foremost of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a valley, to suffice or sustain its inhabitants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The corrected lexical reading has the valley as subject and its people as the sufficed party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be taken and slain, especially when referring to a chief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive construction used of a leader who is seized and killed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To branch out or become abundant in branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the branches of trees and, by extension, of a valley that branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be derived or deduced from a fundamental principle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of questions, propositions, or subsidiary matters that ramify from an أصل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set upon people with reviling or similar verbal attack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative transitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become superior or excel in eminence or nobility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of becoming pre-eminent over a group or other persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To marry into the highest or noblest part of a family, especially by marrying its chief woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative social-status construction used with a family or tribe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deflower or devirgin a maiden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII sexual usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To broach an ode or originate novel meanings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative literary extension of opening or initiating something new.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper or uppermost part of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the upper part of an object, including the upper part of an ear or eyeball.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A branch, subdivision, or derivative founded upon a fundamental whole or principle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Opposed to أصل; includes the technical sense of a derivative discipline or rule.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hair of a woman, or full and abundant hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or collective nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A noble or eminent person of a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a leading or distinguished member of a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A valley branching off, or a channel carrying water to a ravine or watercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical sense; its plural in this use is فِرَاعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow made from the extreme portion or tip of a branch; by extension, a bow of a specified un-split construction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term in descriptions of bows, also used adjectivally with قوس.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beneficial or serviceable property that has been made ready.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A disputed or possibly metonymic usage; the evidence also suggests that some attestations may retain the sense “branch.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first offspring of a camel, sheep, or goat, especially one sacrificed for blessing; by ellipsis, the skin of such an offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term belongs to the pre-Islamic firstling sacrifice and related custom described in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A louse, especially according to some authorities a small louse; according to others, a large louse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The size distinction is a reported lexical disagreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food prepared on the occasion of camels giving birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A customary food term analogous to a childbirth feast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion or share, sometimes specifically a share of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water-specific limitation is attributed only to some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A high or elevated place, such as the upper part of a mountain, valley, date receptacle, or road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote the conspicuous summit or upper end and, in descriptions of a road, its sides or borders.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The early or first part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the temporal expression فِي فَرْعَةٍ مِنَ النَّهَارِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The blood of a virgin released on defloration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun associated with the act of devirginization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of skin added to a partially sized or incomplete water-skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for repairing or enlarging a water container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of an asterism associated with the season of the most intense heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records variant explanations of the astronomical name and its identification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A poetic or dialectal variant of فِرْعَوْنُ, Pharaoh, the proper name or title of an ancient ruler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A foreign proper name; the form may be used by poetic license.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High, tall, or overtopping what is adjacent; by extension, elevated, beautiful, or eminent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of mountains, people, form or appearance, and rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, ignoble, or mean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary sense reported for the same adjective by one line of lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a particular expression, moving in opposite vertical directions, with one person ascending and the other descending.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional contextual use illustrated by meeting two people moving in contrary directions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An armed attendant or guard of a ruler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Singular corresponding to فَرَعَةٌ in this specialized social sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The higher or highest part of a mountain or valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical feminine noun for an elevated part; its plural may describe elevated torrent channels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Surplus property deducted from the main stock of spoils before division into fifths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized legal or distribution term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence also records the variant form فَيْفَرَعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full-haired or free from deficiency in the hair of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a man in opposition to أصلع and, according to the cited distinction, of a woman meaning abundantly haired; feminine فَرْعَاءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One subject to diabolical promptings or suggestions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage attested in a traditional expression about who should lead prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general adjective of height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad, high, or projecting at the shoulder blade.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or of a shoulder blade itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who interposes between disputing persons and effects reconciliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Agent noun; plural مَفَارِعُ.

cautions: The public headword فَرْعٌ is the normalized citation form; the supplied Quran occurrence is the construct form فَرْعُهَا.
The single Quranic sense is supported by the explicit Quran-focused lexical discussion and the branch sense of the classical noun; the contextual English gloss is illustrative only.
